name: On-chain activity CONFIRMS breakout -> participation-backed long (BTC)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (distinct from the two bearish-divergence fades: this is the POSITIVE-confirmation mirror — it only goes LONG a breakout when on-chain participation is RISING with price, avoiding the unconfirmed thin rallies the fades short): a price breakout backed by rising btc_active_addresses AND rising btc_tx_count is organic, participation-driven demand — real new users and settlement flowing in behind the move, the opposite of the ETF-only thin rally. Buying only confirmed breakouts should sidestep the false pushes. Entry: price near range highs AND active addresses above a floor AND tx_count above a floor. Long; exit on activity rolling over or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1 (confound): activity is structurally decaying via L2 leakage -> the 'rising activity' condition may almost never fire, starving the strategy of trades; KILL if effective-N is too thin to gate. DISCONFIRMER 2: if a plain range-breakout long matches the deflated Sharpe, the activity confirmation adds nothing. DISCONFIRMER 3: activity can lag price -> KILL if the confirmation only fires after the move is spent. Net of fees, DSR>=0.95.
catalyst: breakout confirmed by rising on-chain participation and throughput
